description: Beautifully upgraded home featuring 4 beds and 2 bath with Italian marble-style tile flooring, a stunning fireplace, and laminate flooring in all the bedrooms. The remodeled kitchen offers modern finishes and functionality, while both bathrooms have been updated with new tiles, vanities and LED-lite mirrors. Additional improvements include recessed lighting throughout, all new interior doors, a new front entry door, and a solar-powered automatic wrought-iron driveway gate with matching side access gates. Property also equipped with EV charger and cameras. Outdoor amenities include a gazebo, a mini outdoor kitchen with a brand-new BBQ grill, and extensive hardscape improvements with paving throughout the driveway, side yards, and backyard. Thoughtfully enhanced for comfortable living and entertaining, this move-in-ready home offers exceptional indoor and outdoor appeal.
